main_idea: AfterQuery warmup raises Nemotron 3 Ultra’s GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: Warmup improves Nemotron 3 Ultra’s GDPval score.
Warmup brings the score close to the teacher.
Nemotron 3 Ultra has about six times the throughput of comparable open models.
